units.en: The ultimate goal of ⟦0⟧ path is to aquire enough resources to complete ⟦1⟧, which would completely remove the CGFF penalty and provide even more benefits, including buffing ⟦2⟧. The resources must be within the territory of you or your subjects (not counting your ally). Resources spent on production and export still counts, but resources imported from other countries, including your ally, don't count. Don't forget you need to control all of your core states as well.
The followings are the required resources:
Once completed, ⟦0⟧ will evolve into ⟦1⟧ and CGFF will be set to 0% permanently.

MEFO Bills system provides drastically different mechanics based on the path you choose that'll suit players with different playstyle. From a more relaxed, late-game booming strategy that allows you to slowly build up, to a more aggressive, early rushing strategy with the aim of crushing the opponents before they have time to grow.

⟦0⟧ path is suitable for new players and those who prefer booming. This path is less taxing on new players as it requires less micromanagement and provides more room for error. Since you couldn't produce much equipment in early stages anyway, you can follow standard procedure and focus on developing technology, building economic structures and doing other preparation that doesn't cost too much equipment. As you are quite vulnerable militarily during this stage you should avoid starting or joining the war, only send some attache and a few volunteers to earn some XP. Two focuses are locked behind 1939 technologies, so feel free to develop other branches of national focus once you hit the hurdle to no waste time on ahead-of-time penalty. By the time you complete ⟦1⟧, World Tension should be high enough for the remaining focuses. Complete the focus immediately and rush military factories to catch up with other countries as soon as possible. By this time newer models of tanks or other equipment should become available so you can ignore 1936 or other old models in favor of producing newer models. This path provides more ⟦2⟧, a lot of free ⟦3⟧ and better Construction Speed buffs that benefit not only factories, but all buildings including infrastructures, railways, forts, research facilities and many others that The Four-Year Plan path doesn't provide, giving you a more balanced & productive late game economy as long as you can protect them.

⟦0⟧ path is suitable for experienced players who excel at combat and prefer starting the war as soon as possible. Your military will be ready sooner, allowing you to both rush your opponents before they are fully developed and prevent others from rushing you. This is especially important if you're playing multiplayer or non-historical AI. Be warned though as you'll be faced with a lot of pressure in this path, so it's advised to make a plan before you start. An experienced player can ready their army in 1938/39 quite comfortably in this path, while in the other path it might be delayed to 1940s or even later. As you have good production on equipment early on, you should exercise your military frequently and send as many volunteers as possible. This will improve the quality of your troops and grind tons of XP, allowing you to rush doctrines & technologies as well as design better templates. Use price control decisions strategically to maximize the benefit and avoid stacking the penalties together. Although rushing Anschluss has its benefits, it's also worth it to let ⟦1⟧ & ⟦2⟧ build up more factories. The more they build, the more you'll get after annexing them and the more CGFF they can reduce. If there's some spare time, you can delay the war for as long as possible if you wish as the intelligence bonus of MEFO Bills will be lost upon turning into Economy of Conquest, but you'll still be forced into war eventually after exhausting all other options to lower CGFF. In this path you'll want a swift victory and avoid dragging out because the clock is still ticking before your economy gets crushed by the heavy penalty of CGFF, so don't forget to seize gold reserves before creating the Reichskommissariat. Just be mindful of resistance and avoid seizing too many countries at the same time. Resource-rich states are priority targets as the resources required to remove CGFF are quite steep. In normal circumstances you would need to conquer either Soviet or Allied colonies to get enough resources, but your industry and unique laws will help you with this mountainous task. Even though the maximum possible factories in this path are fewer than the Prioritize Economic Growth path, construction of ⟦3⟧ is much faster in this path and each factory provides a larger bonus in output and is much more resistant to enemy bombing, which will save lots of time on building and repairing. Lack of ⟦4⟧ can be somewhat compensated by selling surplus equipment into the arms market. The unique laws also allow you to be more efficient with ⟦5⟧ and resources. ⟦6⟧ can help you achieve ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧ independence against embargo and blockade. Apart from warfare, you should also build up resource-producing states as it can not only help with production but also help you meet the requirements. Eventually, after completing ⟦9⟧, the burdens will be gone and the production will skyrocket, which allows you to take your time building up and researching super weapons to challenge other superpowers such as ⟦10⟧.
